postal.name: India Post (Postman / GDS / Postal Assistant)
postal.desc: Joining India's postal department — from village-level Gramin Dak Sevak to Postal Assistant.
postal.entrance: GDS: 10th pass, merit-based on 10th marks, no written exam. Postman/Mail Guard: 12th pass. Postal Assistant: 12th pass + exam.
higherStudies: Departmental promotion exams to Postal Assistant, Postmaster, and higher grades
topRecruiters: Department of Posts, Ministry of Communications, Government of India
futureScope: Steady government job with permanence after probation and a clear promotion path
